scripts.build: vite build && esbuild src/content/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/content/index.js --target=es2022 --format=iife && esbuild src/worker/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/worker/index.js --target=es2022 --format=esm && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'dist/manifest.json'); fs.mkdirSync('content', { recursive: true }); fs.mkdirSync('worker', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('dist/content/index.js', 'content/index.js'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/worker/index.js', 'worker/index.js'); })"
